title: NxAuctionHouse
description: NxAuctionHouse brings a complete auction system with GUI browsing, economy integration, safe transactions, and a reliable database backend.
body:
# NxAuctionHouse

NxAuctionHouse is a secure and production-ready Auction House plugin for Paper servers.

Designed for stable server environments with safe transactions, GUI management, database reliability, and a smooth player experience.

## Features

### Auction House

- GUI-based auction browsing
- Sell, buy, and cancel listings
- Item search and filtering
- Category browsing
- Sorting by price, time, and seller
- Pagination support
- Listing expiration system

### Secure Transactions

NxAuctionHouse focuses on protecting player items and money.

Includes:

- Purchase confirmation system
- Protection against double purchases
- Safe item delivery
- Transaction recovery
- Price validation
- Crash-safe operations

### Warehouse System

Recover and manage auction items safely.

Features:

- Personal warehouse storage
- Expired item recovery
- Cancelled listing recovery
- GUI item management
- Safe claiming system

### Economy Support

Supports server economies through Vault.

Features:

- Seller payouts
- Configurable taxes
- Economy failure recovery
- Safe balance handling

Vault is optional.

### Database

Includes a reliable built-in storage system.

Supported:

- SQLite (default)
- MariaDB

Features:

- Automatic database setup
- Automatic migrations
- Upgrade support
- Crash-safe database handling

### Languages

Included translations:

- English
- Vietnamese
- Japanese
- Chinese

All messages can be customized.

## Commands

### Player Commands
/ah
/ah sell
/ah buy
/ah search
/ah profile
/warehouse


### Admin Commands


/nxah diagnose
/nxah reload
/nxah database


## Permissions


nxah.use
nxah.sell
nxah.buy
nxah.cancel
nxah.warehouse
nxah.admin


## Requirements

- Paper 1.21+
- Java 17+

Optional:

- Vault (for economy features)

## Installation

1. Download the plugin jar
2. Place it inside your plugins folder
3. Restart your server
4. Configure the plugin if needed

## Notes

NxAuctionHouse is built with reliability in mind:

- No item duplication
- No lost items during failures
- Safe database operations
- Designed for long-term server use

## Support

If you find issues or have suggestions, please report them with your server version and logs.
